# Heartfall: an allegedly AI-decompiled guide site disclaimed by the game account

Category: Games and preservation · Other AI-assisted work
Record date: 2026-10-19
Stage: Needs verification

At 23:09 Beijing time on October 19, @kazehita_, whose display name includes HEARTFALL OFFICIAL, says they are aware of a website purporting to provide a guide created from an AI decompilation of Heartfall. The account explicitly says it is unofficial and recommends fan-created guides. The target is deriving player guidance from game logic, not porting the game. The candidate is a response from the game's side, not a technical account by the site builder.

Retrieving the original confirmed the account and wording, but supplied no site URL, builder, game version, model, extraction records or guide-accuracy measurements. REA use is unconfirmed. Acknowledging a site does not prove successful AI decompilation, correct guides or established infringement. The October 19 candidate snapshot of 131 likes, 952 views and 23 reposts describes circulation, not technical acceptance.
